messages:
emma: Heads up - found partially redacted payloads in sampled traces for /v1/complete. looks like email local-parts survived.
ops-bot: alert: partial-redact-detected route=/v1/complete count=4 in 15m :warning:
dan: yikes. was that the new quota-aware sampler?
emma: yes. sampler shortcut for low quota routes skipped the deep-field scrub. example snippet (sanitized):
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/complete",
  "input": "Contact: alice@example.com (sent via client)"
}
```
rachel: partial-redaction is worse than none in some legal contexts. We need deterministic tokenization on fallback, not half-scrub.
tom: agreed. proposal: sampler must call redact() then sample. If redact() errors or times out, return a fallback token like `[EML:<h>]` where h = HMAC_SHA256(tenant_key, value)[:12]. mark sample metadata `redact.status=fallback_tokenized`.
dan: implementation detail: sampler runs in proxy layer for latency reasons. We need a tiny non-blocking redact RPC that returns either success or error quickly. If it errors, do tokenization locally using tenant HMAC key from local secret cache.
emma: we must avoid storing raw values in telemetry at all. Telemetry table should only ever have one of: hashed-fingerprint, pseudonym-token, or a small length-limited preview with no separators. no raw email strings.
ops-bot: proposal recorded: redact-before-sample invariant. audit.feature.enforce_redact_before_sample created by tom ts=5867590155
 rachel: telemetry metrics to add: `redact.failure_rate`, `redact.fallback_tokenized`, `sampler.quota_skips`. add a small sampled debug sink that stores 1 in 1000 raw hashed fingerprints only, no raw payloads.
dan: console UX: add route-level indicator "Redact enforced" and an incident banner when `redact.fallback_tokenized > 0` in last 1h. ops should be able to flip emergency-lockdown to `inspect.mode=strip-all` for a route.
tom: ops command ready: `redwoodctl policy set --route /v1/complete --inspect-mode strip-all --reason "partial redact leak"`
emma: before lockdown, quarantine current sampled rows and pseudonymize them for forensic access. quarantined rows must be accessible only via breakglass and must leave an audit record.
ops-bot: action: quarantined 50 samples for route=/v1/complete user=tom ts=5867590178 :white_check_mark:
 rachel: security note: tenant HMAC keys should live in KMS and local cache with auto-refresh. rotate keys monthly and ensure truncated tokens are 12 hex chars to reduce brute force risk. add a check to limit token entropy exposure.
dan: tests: unit test to assert sampler cannot skip redact() when route flag `enforce_redact=true`. integration test to simulate redact RPC failure and assert fallback tokenization and telemetry metadata is present.
emma: quick patch: deny `x-sample-quick` and any debug headers on production/canary unless explicitly allowed by RBAC. we'll add a health check that asserts redact path latency < 200ms 99th pct.
tom: deploying quick lockdown now unless objections.
ops-bot: deploy: feature enforce_redact_before_sample set=on target=/v1/complete user=tom commit=b7c4f2 :white_check_mark:
emma: thanks. follow up RFC for fallback token format, key rotation, metrics and console flows due EOW. closing once RFC merged. :thumbsup:
